The Kevin Bacon Challenge · Australian chapter

Kevin’s Queensland adventure

A little travelling tag, a geocacher with a camera, and a trip full of unexpected places — from the famous golden toilet to the peaceful Mary River.

📍 Wide Bay–Burnett, Queensland🗓 29 October – 21 November 2026📷 Photos by geocacher ms_sammii
Explore the photographs ↓
Pages from the travelling scrapbook

One small tag. So many stories.

On 29 October 2026, ms_sammii retrieved “Kevin Bacon” from Dolphintouch’s Stormwater Lookout! (GCBXB5Z) geocache in Hervey Bay. She planned to take him caching around Maryborough, Childers and Woodgate. By 31 October, he was already making memories around Maryborough — with a little help from ian-and-penny, who logged discovering him during their cache outing together.

Hervey Bay→Maryborough→Mary River region→More cache visits
29 October 2026

Kevin hits the road

ms_sammii retrieves Kevin from Stormwater Lookout! and offers to carry him on a two-week caching adventure.

Geocaching log: Grabbed from GCBXB5Z.
31 October 2026

A memorable day in Maryborough

Mary River Adventure Labs, a cache raid with friends, painted murals, a golden toilet and photographs at local landmarks — Kevin seems to have seen it all!

ms_sammii shared a Maryborough write note; ian-and-penny recorded a discovery.
5–15 November 2026

Still part of the caching day

More visit logs show Kevin accompanying ms_sammii on cache visits and outings with cache owners doing maintenance.

Visited logs on 5, 7, 14 and 15 November. A visit log does not necessarily mean the tag was left behind.

New chapter · 21 November 2026

Traveller #3 explores Childers & Woodgate

The journey continues! Geocacher ms_sammii took Kevin Bacon Travel Bug #3 on a day of Queensland geocaching, sharing photographs of local landmarks, colourful community libraries, coastal scenery and beautiful bushland. Each little stop helps tell the story of the people and places connected by the challenge.

Hervey Bay→Childers→Woodgate Beach→More adventures ahead
21 November 2026

History & community

Photographs include the Childers Historical Complex, a cannon and a welcome sign, plus colourful community-library murals full of books, imagination and a reading frog.

21 November 2026

Along the coastline

Woodgate Beach, Walkers Point and nearby coastal stops feature sandy shores, a seawall, the ocean walkway and dramatic storm clouds.

21 November 2026

The little moments

A flowering shrub, bush tracks, a geocache container, a mural at the Woodgate Men's Shed and a quick rest beside a water bottle complete the day.

Geocaching snapshot, 21 November: 130.9 miles (about 211 km), 45 tracking-history records and 34 gallery photographs. Many of these are visits with the same geocacher, rather than separate retrievals or drop-offs.
